name: Robotics
boundaries: Robotics: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.reason: ROB-02 covers the dexterous capability; ROB-01 covers unstructured task use. One architecture for any hand is a stricter proposal under ROB-02.

original_dispositions.original_title: Provably safe physical human–robot interaction with a mathematical guarantee of zero injury under arbitrary human behavior or any failure
original_dispositions.reason: The usable remainder is a certification condition on ROB-01 and ROB-10; the arbitrary-behavior zero-injury guarantee is stated more strongly than physics allows.

original_dispositions.original_title: Biological energy efficiency for locomotion and manipulation, stated as about 25 percent or better
original_dispositions.reason: The 25 percent figure is not tied to a verified robot metric; locomotion efficiency is partly approached and the endurance gap is substantially energy storage. Muscle-like actuation remains ROB-03.

original_dispositions.original_title: One-shot lifelong learning and zero-forgetting transfer across any embodiment
original_dispositions.reason: One-shot and any-body transfer are recorded as a stricter proposal for the same learning capability.

original_dispositions.original_title: Robust emergent swarm intelligence for thousands to millions of heterogeneous robots
original_dispositions.reason: Local-rule swarm research already exists. The construction outcome is ROB-08; scale alone is not treated as a distinct discovery at the calibration bar.
ROB-05 covers shape change and module-level repair; growth of new material from onboard feedstock overlaps ROB-04.
ROB-07 covers predictive physical consequences for contact planning; ROB-01 covers choosing and sequencing unfamiliar jobs.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal low-cost, high-performance soft actuation and sensing
original_dispositions.reason: Actuation and cost at scale are covered by ROB-03. Distributed sensing is not added separately; it would help ROB-02 but does not itself establish the stated manipulation capability.

original_dispositions.original_title: Provably correct and explainable decision-making at mission scale
original_dispositions.reason: The notes treat this as a certification and accountability condition, not a new physical capability or field-founding principle.

original_dispositions.original_title: Morphological intelligence principle that derives an optimal body from a task so that “the brain comes for free”
original_dispositions.reason: Morphological computation is an existing approach; the automatic optimal-body claim is stronger than the research program supports. Relevant hardware consequences sit in ROB-03 and ROB-05.
